summary: Correct PR #37's late-activation continuity gap by binding recognized material/failure/learning signals to explicit known-candidate routing through the existing Material State / BB-INTEGRATE / Planning Owner path, regression-protect match|no-match|uncertain-match and activation authority boundaries, and preserve current P2 scope and execution gate.

requirements.rationale: The operationalization snapshot maps current real-use gaps to existing Requirements without changing Requirement text, criticality or authority. Future activation may re-evaluate whether refinement is needed.

issues_findings.rationale: Independent qualitative review found a specific passive-archive gap in Option F: a later signal could be persisted without reliably rejoining the known OC candidate. The correction makes that routing disposition explicit and reviewable while preserving the original audit/candidate evidence.

risks.rationale: The correction directly addresses passive-archive/continuity risk while retaining anti-bloat and authority boundaries: no-match and uncertainty remain valid, and a satisfied matched trigger yields at most an activation candidate.

decisions_concepts.rationale: The correction refines the existing Material State / BB-INTEGRATE procedure so recognized material/failure/learning signals must record match|no-match|uncertain-match against persistent known candidate evidence before activation. Semantic matching remains judgement. No new Building Block, registry, matcher service, priority, promotion, admission or implementation authority is created.

derived_views.rationale: Refresh the derived current-state reconciliation provenance to the known-candidate-routing correction; baseline counts and execution authority remain unchanged.

planning_execution_cursor.rationale: Known-candidate routing correction does not manufacture programme priority. Current P2 preflight remains complete, p2-implementation-admission remains blocked on explicit Human admission, implementation_allowed remains false, and P2 does not depend on PR #37 promotion.

active_work.rationale: PR #37 correction is review work on the candidate package. No OC implementation and no P2 implementation is activated.
